title: Bubble Bath Pop
description: Pop shimmering rainbow soap bubbles rising across a playful bathtub arena—chain sparkling bursts before bubbles float away.
controls: Aim and shoot bubbles into matching color groups to pop sparkling soapy chains.

zh-CN.title: 浴室打水泡
zh-CN.description: 清新欢乐休闲浴室打水泡：瞄准升腾的七彩肥皂泡泡连发射击触发满屏爆裂，清脆解压一局接一局！
zh-CN.controls: 瞄准发射彩色泡泡凑齐同色爆破，清空全场水泡赢取高分。
